tara-sec: FYI we have an upcoming pentest from Northbridge on 2024-11-12. Need to finalize intake: exact scope (staging ingest + model-serving), RBAC pattern, KMS rules for exported evidence, retention, and a retest slot. Can we decide today?

evan-eng: Scope ack: staging ingest pipelines and model serving infra only. No customer PII or production keys in exports. RBAC: create `pt-assessor` role with s3:GetObject on `pt-exports/northbridge/*`, cloudwatch:Describe/FilterLogs for logs, and read-only metrics. No write or secrets access.

rachel-sre: Observability export spec: include logs, traces, and select metrics. Required fields in packaged logs: timestamp, service, trace_id, request_id, principal_hash, action, resource, status, latency_ms, error_message. Sampling policy: errors=100%, auth paths=100%, other traffic=0.5% by default. Redaction pipeline will remove ip_address, email, and free-form user_text. Retention of PT artifacts: 90 days. Exports go to `s3://pt-exports/northbridge/`.

noah-legal: Legal: external assessors must sign NDA + data handling addendum before any access. Also require checklist: destroy instructions after retention period. Add a contract clause for audit-proof logs generated by our readroom.

tara-sec: KMS policy decision: NO direct kms:Decrypt for assessors. We'll provide envelope-encrypted blobs using a service key. For any request that requires plaintext, use the secure readroom: dual-approval (sec + eng), MFA, and ephemeral decrypt executed by central ops principal which will log requestor, approver, ticket ID.

evan-eng: I'll open tracker REDINF-1412 and attach infra plan + terraform snippet to create assessor role and bucket policy. Proposed helper script: `./infra/create_pt_assessor.sh --name northbridge --duration 4h`. Adding automated pre-window verification `./verification/check_pt_role.sh northbridge`.

evidence-bot: Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pt-evidence-packaging. Manifest requirements: exported_at, exporter, file_list, checksums, schema_v. Packaging tool: `tools/pt-pack --src /var/logs/pt-sample --out s3://pt-exports/northbridge/manifest.zip`.

rachel-sre: Ops pre-checks to include in the runbook:
1) `./verification/check_pt_role.sh northbridge`
2) `./tools/export-logs --start 2024-11-12T00:00Z --end 2024-11-12T06:00Z --fields=timestamp,service,trace_id,request_id,principal_hash,action,resource,status --out /tmp/northbridge-sample.zip`
3) `./tools/pt-pack --src /tmp/northbridge-sample.zip --out s3://pt-exports/northbridge/`

tara-sec: SLAs: curated artifact delivery = 24 hours during business days. Live sampling or ad hoc captures: acknowledgement within 2 hours, target delivery within 8 hours. Retest window proposed: Tue 2024-11-19 09:00-13:00 PST. Who will coordinate calendar and checks?

evan-eng: I'll coordinate retest invites and own REDINF-1412. Will add verification job to run 30 mins before window.

noah-legal: I'll prepare the NDA addendum and signoff checklist. Also ensure audit-proof artifacts are stored under `s3://pt-exports/audit-proofs/northbridge/`.

tara-sec: Great, I'll draft the intake doc (scope, RBAC role, KMS decision = no decrypt, redaction, SLAs, readroom flow, retest window) and circulate for signoff. Ping me for signoff. Thanks team :thumbsup:
